description: Installs the jj-vcs/jj Jujutsu VCS from a sha256-pinned tarball release. No package manager is used, so it works on any distro with curl and tar.
name: jj

sha256.description: sha256 of the jj-v<version>-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz asset for the given version. Must be updated together with version.

version.description: jj version to install, without a leading 'v'.
